The tt phase margin is 42°, short of the 61° target. UGBW is already about 2× the spec, so I'll trade some bandwidth for phase: raise Cc and push the second-stage pole outward. To do that, use more I7 and a shorter L4, which cuts the mirror/gate capacitance and raises gm7. The topology is fine, so this is a parameter refinement.

```json
{"action": "refine",
 "reason": "PM 42° vs 61°, but UGBW is 2x the spec. Raise Cc to ~1.6p, push the 2nd-stage pole up (more I7, shorter L4 for lower c1 and higher gm7), and set Rz for a LHP zero. Gain (81 dB) and power have margin to absorb this.",
 "params": {"cc": 1.6e-12, "i7": 180e-6, "L4": 0.6, "rzk": 2.5, "gmid1": 16.0, "itail": 42e-6, "gmid4": 9.0},
 "bounds": {"cc": [1.2e-12, 2.2e-12], "i7": [140e-6, 200e-6], "L4": [0.5, 1.0], "rzk": [1.5, 4.0], "itail": [36e-6, 55e-6], "gmid4": [7.0, 11.0]}}
```
